The second photo shows only an "Oops!" card and no tray, so the leftovers can't be seen. I assumed everything was eaten, which makes leftover energy 0. The second photo may have been taken in error, so this is a guess.

Estimated items served:
- Muesli with raisins, about 50 g: 180 kcal, 5 g protein, 34 g carbs, 3 g fat.
- Greek yogurt cup, about 100 g: 100 kcal, 10 g protein, 5 g carbs, 4 g fat.
- Strawberries, about 80 g: 25 kcal, 0.5 g protein, 6 g carbs, 0 g fat.
- Sourdough slice, about 70 g: 180 kcal, 6 g protein, 35 g carbs, 1 g fat.
- Poached or fried egg: 90 kcal, 6 g protein, 0.5 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- Mushrooms, cooked with a little oil: 40 kcal, 2 g protein, 3 g carbs, 3 g fat.
- Honey packet, about 14 g: 45 kcal, 0 g protein, 12 g carbs, 0 g fat.
- Coffee, possibly with milk: 15 kcal, 1 g protein, 1 g carbs, 1 g fat.

These add up to about 675 kcal, 30.5 g protein, 96.5 g carbs and 19 g fat. I rounded the totals in the reply.
